company.name: BlueCargo
company.shortDescription: BlueCargo is a predictive algorithm platform that monitors, forecasts, and optimizes operations in container ports.
company.description: BlueCargo is a predictive algorithm platform that brings visibility to optimize operations in seaport terminals. Their proprietary predictive algorithms streamline container management to increase terminal’s productivity while reducing operational costs and enhancing the quality of the service.

productsAndServices.description: A software platform that monitors, forecasts, and manages container movements and demurrage and detention charges at port terminals.
productsAndServices.name: BlueCargo Container Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service that audits per diem invoices for compliance and accuracy, helping customers dispute and reduce detention and demurrage charges.
productsAndServices.name: Per Diem Invoice Audit and Dispute Service

productsAndServices.description: A feature that provides access to terminal gate and vessel schedules for multiple steamship lines and port terminals to aid container movement planning.
productsAndServices.name: Terminal and Vessel Schedule Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: A tool to track container status and maintain a watchlist for monitoring shipments and managing container flow through ports.
productsAndServices.name: Container Shipment Watchlist and Tracking

productsAndServices.description: A dashboard providing reporting on container operations and a system to manage custom contracts related to container handling and per diem charges.
productsAndServices.name: Reporting Dashboard and Custom Contract Management

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $11,000,000, or 57.89% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,446,285 to $62,168,252, a 13.98x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 29 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
